name: shop.xmasgift/gifts
title: Xmasgift.shop Gift Guide
description: Non-Amazon Christmas gift guide: 406 curated gifts, recorded prices, links to maker shops.

tools.name: search_gifts
tools.description: Search xmasgift.shop's verified-price, non-Amazon gift catalog. Returns at most 20 gifts with tracked https://www.xmasgift.shop/go/... affiliate_url links. Only gifts with a recorded price and price_verified_at are included. Does not sell anything; purchases happen on the brand site. Never returns Amazon links. Prices are recorded check-date prices, not live prices.

query.description: Optional free-text match against name, brand, why_we_picked_it, category, and seller_note.

recipient.description: Optional recipient tag to match (e.g. mom, dad, kids, teens, grandparents, pets, him, her). Case-insensitive; must appear in the gift's recipient array.

budget_tier.description: Optional budget tier of the recorded price.

category.description: Optional category match (e.g. Tech, Pets, Experiences, Jewelry). Case-insensitive exact match on the gift's category.

affiliate_only.description: If true, return only gifts with is_affiliate true (a live commission program). Default false (include tracked /go/ links that may not earn).

limit.description: Max results to return. Default 10, maximum 20.

tools.name: get_gift_details
tools.description: Get one gift from the verified-price catalog by its id (for example uhc-lincoln-brief). Returns the recorded price, price_verified_at, recipients, seller_note, why_we_picked_it, and the tracked affiliate_url. Does not fetch a live price.

id.description: Gift id from the catalog or from search_gifts.

tools.name: verify_price
tools.description: Return the recorded price_usd and price_verified_at for a gift id. This tool never fetches or claims a live price from the brand site. Always tell the user to confirm the current price on the brand's website before buying.

id.description: Gift id from the catalog or from search_gifts.
